labels.label: T-abs-curves-extend-second-countable (no paper label; the target's statement, programme/roadmap.toml:987)
labels.notes: Nothing is marked, which is right: there is no paper. The only bold-backtick item in the file is the declaration docstring **`CurvesExtend`** at :1398. It is outside the module docstring and has no 'prefix:' form, so tools/ledger.py's mark regex (:247) does not read it. (1) THE DEFINITIONS. The statement uses the library's definitions unchanged. #print gives Causality.CurvesExtendOn (Causal/CBG/CausalConvex.lean:153) and CurvesExtend (Causal/CauchyExtension.lean:82) as: every causal curve over [a, b], a <= b, gives some I and c' with Inextensible W I c' and c '' Icc a b ⊆ c' '' I. Inextensible (Causal/Inextensible.lean:184) is CausalCurveIn W I c together with not Extensible. StrictlyExtends (:171) asks three things: c' a causal curve over I'; some φ strictly increasing on I, MapsTo I I', with ordconnected image and c' ∘ φ = c; and a value of c' that c never takes. This is DEC-11 and DEC-13, the author's rulings (registers/DECISIONS.md:22, :24). ETT defines 'causal curve' (ETT.tex:360) but never 'inextensible', which it uses at :1252, :1295-1296, :1875-1877 and :2203-2230, so the rulings are what ETT means here. The file redefines none of these: its 30 names are new, and none shadows a library constant. (2) THE STATEMENT IS REAL, NOT NEAR-TRIVIAL. The 'image grows' clause defeats padding by constant pieces (exists_naive_extension). The reparametrisation clause defeats domain-maximality: t ↦ min t 0 over ℝ is extensible (timelikeLine_not_inextensible_min), and so is id over [0, 1] (timelikeLine_not_inextensible_Icc). A point curve over {a}, a constant curve over ℝ, and a curve converging at an open end are all extensible as soon as a causal curve leaves or reaches the point. Only causally stuck ends are inextensible. The permissive cases (a surjective curve, or a closed loop run forever, is inextensible) are disclosed in Inextensible.lean's SCOPE. They arise only in non-causal spacetimes, and the proof does not use them: it is Zorn on towers, a direct limit for countable cofinality and the ω₁ lemma for uncountable cofinality, uniform in the causality. The conclusion is the library's image form. The proof yields more, a sub-arc form (see build.details, observation (a)). Since only the library's definitions and [T1Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] appear, the kernel settles truth, and what is left to check is meaning and clashes. (3) NO CLASH WITH THE LIBRARY'S MODELS. No statement of the form ¬ ... CurvesExtend(On) exists in Causal/ or scaffold/ (grep). The ladder has no [[fails]] with to = curves_extend. In tools/ladder.py's counterexample() no counterexample lacks curves_extend, with or without the fact (simulation, build.details). The one counterexample off T1 is the vee (space T0), to which the fact does not apply. Every library model with CurvesExtend agrees: timelikeLine, rationalLine, gateLine, halfChronoLine, the non-causal flat time cylinder (timeCylinder_curvesExtend), static and Minkowski, E0 (Port/E0Strong.lean:565). So do the ladder's fork, loop fan and notched plane (ladder.toml:2478). The long ray is CurvesExtend's conjectured counterexample, with no inextensible curve (CurvesExtend.lean:90-99, LemmaKReduction.lean:62-66, ladder.toml:2478). It is not second countable, so there is no clash. LemmaKObstruction's vacuous charts are only 'what a counterexample must be', never constructed, so there is no clash there either; they are now impossible on T1, second countable spaces (observation (b)). No Causal.lightlikeLine statement concerns CurvesExtend. Splitting.lean:999 only identifies its Extensible with timelikeLine's. (4) ANY INTERVAL. exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable takes C.CausalCurveIn W I c for any I (non-empty and ordconnected, as CausalCurveIn requires: singletons, open, half-open and unbounded intervals included). It concludes that some J and γ have C.Inextensible W J γ and c '' I ⊆ γ '' J. curvesExtendOn_of_t1_secondCountable is this theorem at I = Icc a b (through causalCurveIn_Icc). The claim is true. REPORT statement.true calls the interval form 'a strictly stronger theorem'. It is the more general form: it implies the segment form, and the converse is not examined. Under the same standing both are now theorems, so 'more general' is the accurate word. (5) THE STATEMENTS (#check with pp.universes). curvesExtendOn_of_t1_secondCountable is ∀ {M : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace M] [T1Space M] [SecondCountableTopology M] (C : Causality M) (W : Opens M), C.CurvesExtendOn W. curvesExtend_of_t1_secondCountable is the same with C.CurvesExtend. exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable is as in (4). IsCauchySurface.isAcausal_of_t1_secondCountable is IsCauchySurface.isAcausal with its CurvesExtend argument removed and nothing added. IsCauchySurfaceOn.eq_of_le_of_t1_secondCountable is IsCauchySurfaceOn.eq_of_le with its CurvesExtendOn B argument removed and nothing added. No other instance or hypothesis appears. (6) KEY LEMMAS, none vacuous. exists_seq_limit: its hypotheses (causal tail-free curves c n over I n, and φ n strictly monotone into I (n+1) with ordconnected image and c (n+1) ∘ φ n = c n) are satisfiable, by constant curves over a singleton with φ n = id, or by sub-segments of id on the timelike line. Its conclusion is a commuting cocone (J, γ, ψ): a causal, tail-free curve with ψ (n+1) ∘ φ n = ψ n and γ ∘ ψ n = c n. The docstring says 'direct limit', and the statement claims only the cocone, which is what ChainsInherit needs. false_of_rightExcess is a refutation lemma. Its hypotheses without hexc are jointly satisfiable (ι = Unit, r = True, I = [0, 1], c = id into ℝ, φ = id). hbound on the empty set only asks ι non-empty. So the content is that cofinal right excesses are impossible when every countable set of indices is bounded: the uncountable-cofinality case of a total preorder. Only continuity of each c i is used, not causality. false_of_leftExcess is its mirror image through t ↦ -t. exists_tailFree_retraction (T1, c continuous on segments) gives I₀ ⊆ I, non-empty, ordconnected and tail-free, with a monotone retraction ρ onto I₀ keeping the values, which collapses two points only inside a constant final or initial piece. It is the trimming of the closed constancy sets, and it holds trivially for a constant c (I₀ a point). tailFreeMor_inextensible_of_isMaximal concludes the library's Inextensible, and its hypothesis IsMaximal is satisfiable (exists_isMaximal_of_chainsInherit). IsMaximal is not trivially true: if it were, id over [0, 1] (tail-free) would be inextensible, against timelikeLine_not_inextensible_Icc. tailFreeMor_chainsInherit is AbstractDev.ChainsInherit.{u} for D = TailFreeCurve C W : Type u, the universe that exists_isMaximal_of_chainsInherit asks for. (7) DOCSTRING CONTRACT (kb/0006). It has a title; 'no label is marked'; verbatim quotes of the target title (roadmap.toml:987, identical) and of CauchyExtension.lean:79-81 (identical); '## Hypothesis checklist' (:81); '## SCOPE (disclosed)' (:92); and the Provenance line (:113). The checklist is true: SecondCountableTopology enters only through false_of_right/leftExcess and chainsInherit, and T1 through the retraction, the ω₁ lemma and eq_of_continuousOn_of_rat. The SCOPE is true. The finite-space remark holds when read as 'of maximal image among the curves extending c'. The cited lines are right: CauchyExtension.lean:81, CurvesExtend.lean:97-98, Flat/Develop.lean:1614, ETT.tex:255 (def:category_topological_spacetimes: second countable Hausdorff) and kb/0094.

build.details: BUILD. Before every Lean run I checked that no make, lake build or lean process was running. Root `make -k check` runs by other loops ran during the audit; each time I waited, and I ran nothing while one was in progress. No lake build was run. From lean-causal/: `taskset -c 0-11 lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true scaffold/CausalScaffold/CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean` exits 0 and prints nothing. The source sha256 is 6e3de56e...42b7, 1423 lines, as in the REPORT. Two copies show that the run elaborates proof bodies and does not skip them: one with a false `example` appended reports that error at :1425, and one with `.symm` dropped inside tailFreeMor_inextensible_of_isMaximal reports the mismatch at :1367 (both exit 1, both deleted). The oleans of the three imports are newer than their sources. Inextensible.olean's source mtime is newer, a sync artefact: the file has no diff since commit b4dbb29, built at 00:48 and committed at 00:51. SORRY. The count is 0. A grep for sorry, admit, #exit, axiom, native_decide, unsafe, implemented_by, extern, set_option, macro, elab, opaque, run_cmd and #eval finds nothing. The two sorry mentions in the closure's Causal/CompactCauchy.lean are docstring text in a strict module. AXIOMS. A copy of the file under the campaign directory, with #print axioms for the 30 names of REPORT.axioms, since deleted. All 30 give exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], matching REPORT.axioms. LAYER 1. The imports are exactly Causal.MaximalZorn, Causal.OmegaOneConstant and Causal.CBG.CausalConvex (:1-3). On a /tmp root holding the file as Causal/CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean, tools/ladder.py's _lean_index merged into the live lean_index() gives model_path None for the module and for each of its three imports. The source closure has 47 Causal modules. The compiled closure (a probe with the file's body, env.header.moduleNames) has 4737 modules, 47 of them under Causal, and the two lists are identical to REPORT.closure.modules (48 with the module itself, 4738 with the scaffold olean, as the REPORT counts). The roots are Init, Lean, Std, Mathlib, Batteries, ImportGraph, Aesop, Qq, Plausible, LeanSearchClient, ProofWidgets and Causal. The closure contains no Causal.Minkowski, Static, Flat.*, Model.*, Port.*, SingularFlat, Splitting, LemmaK*, LevinUtility or model-reaching CBG module. The only CBG module is CBG.CausalConvex, and is_model is false for every member. NAMES. The 30 names are not in lean_index()['decls'] of the live Causal/, which includes Model/EAlphaContinuation, Model/EAlphaGX, SFATransfer and Port/SFALocalE0 (all present, oleans built 13:54). A declaration grep of each short name over Causal/, scaffold/, lean-gx, lean-benzecri and Mathlib finds nothing outside the file. The existing Causal.Causality.curvesExtend_of_secondCountable and exists_inextensible_of_secondCountable (LevinTimeFunction.lean:514, :521) differ by '_t1'. The body elaborated after `import Causal` (267 imports, all built) plus its three imports, with -DwarningAsError=true: exit 0, no 'already declared', no ambiguity. The name note is true. Causal.Flat.continuousOn_of_strictMonoOn (Causal/Flat/Develop.lean:1614, namespace Causal.Flat, a model module) asks only StrictMonoOn φ I and an ordconnected image, with no ordconnected domain. So it is the more general lemma, and its proof is model-free (order topology only). The new name is distinct, so no reference can resolve ambiguously. FOR_KEEPER. Simulated with the committed tools/ladder.py (last change 7852b54) on a /tmp copy of programme/ladder.toml, since deleted. Before: check() gives 0 violations; the matrix has 314 pairs within a sort (implied 18, fails 273, open 23); there are 16 [[open]] X → curves_extend entries, at :2475 and :2659-2729. With [[fact]] curves_extend (standing T1, second_countable), and the witness name added to the resolver as after graduation, check() gives exactly 16 violations, each 'open X→curves_extend is already settled; remove it', for the 16 X of REPORT.for_keeper.implied_pairs. With those 16 entries removed from the text as well, check() and _contradictions() give 0. The matrix changes in exactly those 16 pairs, open → implied: implied 34, open 7, fails 273, classified 314 of 314. time_function → curves_extend is implied before and after, through [[implies]] Causal.Causality.HasTimeFunction.curvesExtend (no standing). On the bare space (closure(on=∅)) it stays implied with or without the fact, while is_causal → curves_extend is then not implied: the edge, not the fact, carries the pair off the ambient. SCOPE. git status --short shows the closer's two paths, untracked and in no commit (git log --all). The other changes belong to other targets and loops: programme/roadmap.toml (the master's status edits: this target active, T-lad-record-plain-chronal done), papers/egf/**, roadmap/roadmap.toml and tests/test_corrections.py. The commits since the closer started (5bcad0b, 245a447, bae0342, ...) touch none of the closer's paths. BINDERS (evidence). 7 + 8 localisation rows and 3 open_localisation rows, as the REPORT says. The ERS open_reason quoted is at papers/ers-predictability/certificate/binder.toml:234 and :258. A probe importing the scaffold olean and Causal.CBG.Geometry (since deleted) shows that `fun _ _ => Causality.curvesExtend_of_t1_secondCountable _` inhabits the type of Geometry's A2 field curvesExtend (Geometry.lean:304), and `fun _ => ...` the type of LocalModel's B3 field curvesExtend (Geometry.lean:590). Exit 0 with warnings as errors. The REPORT's note-5 count is right: binders of type ...CurvesExtend(On _) appear in 19 modules (CBG.CausalConvex 23, LemmaKLocal 13, LemmaKBare 12, ErsUnions 7, CompactCauchy 7, LemmaKSC 5, CauchyDiamond 4). OBSERVATIONS for the master (not findings). (a) The proof of exists_inextensible_of_t1_secondCountable yields a morphism f with tailFreeMor X Z f: the trimmed curve, which has the same image, is a reparametrised sub-arc of the inextensible curve. The theorem states only the image form. Causal/CBG/SubExtensionAbstract.lean:84-90 says that IsCauchyEmbedding.exists_mem_image_inf is open because 'the library has curve extension only in the image form (CurvesExtendOn, segments, no reparametrisation)'. A one-line corollary exposing the sub-arc form (of the trimmed curve) would answer that, on T1, second countable spaces. (b) On a T1, second countable space no point has a vacuous chart (Causality.HasVacuousChart, LemmaKObstruction.lean:124): a constant curve at x is a causal curve of U (causalCurveOn_const), and it extends to a U-inextensible curve. So the vacuity route to a counterexample to Lemma K is closed in ETT's (second countable) form. By LemmaKReduction's SCOPE (:57-58), under CurvesExtend the bare form is then equivalent to its criteria (1) and (2). The REPORT does not state this; it is a corollary or a kb line, the master's call.

findings.where: lean-causal/campaign/T-abs-curves-extend-second-countable/REPORT.json notes 4 (library prose made outdated); Causal/CBG/Geometry.lean:583-593; Causal/CurvesExtend.lean:99
findings.what: Of the four library texts listed, two now say something false once the module graduates. The other two do not. (i) CauchyExtension.lean:79-81 is false: 'the library does not prove it for topological spacetimes', and calling it 'a model fact' is no longer accurate. (ii) CurvesExtend.lean:90-99 is false in two sentences: 'Without a time function the Zorn step has no coherent parametrisation, and the transfinite chain of extensions need not stop' (towers remove the choice, and second countability stops the chain), and 'whether CurvesExtend holds in every strongly causal spacetime is open here' (it holds in every T1, second countable one). It stays true only off second countability, for the long ray. (iii) README.md:104 ('every causal curve lies on an inextensible one, when there is a time function') is still true: it describes what Causal.CurvesExtend proves, which has not changed. It needs no edit, at most a pointer to the new module. (iv) The A2 field comment (Geometry.lean:299-303) is still true: the field is consumed on globally hyperbolic developments, and curvesExtend_of_timeFunction discharges it there. What changed is that the field is now redundant: `fun _ _ => Causality.curvesExtend_of_t1_secondCountable _` inhabits its type (probe, build.details). The same holds for LocalModel's B3 field curvesExtend (Geometry.lean:583-593), which the REPORT does not list. Separately, CurvesExtend.lean:99 and LemmaK.lean:42 cite curvesExtend_of_secondCountable as 'Causal.LevinUtility', but since T-abs-hoist-levin it lives in Causal.LevinTimeFunction (:514). That error predates this target, and the same amendment can fix it.
findings.fix: In notes 4: mark (i) and (ii) as false (quote the two sentences of (ii)), (iii) as unchanged, and (iv) as 'a field now dischargeable by curvesExtend_of_t1_secondCountable', and add LocalModel's B3 field beside it. For the graduation amendment: correct the LevinUtility pointer at CurvesExtend.lean:99.
